slides.headline: Your next customer might be *an AI*
slides.sub: Some already spend $200+ an order. Here's what they check before they buy from you.

slides.title: Clear product info
slides.body: Sizes, materials, what's in the box. If it isn't written down, the assistant can't recommend it.
slides.cost: Check: every product page answers the basics

slides.title: Real stock levels
slides.body: Google now tells shoppers when an item's back in stock. Wrong counts mean missed alerts.
slides.cost: Check: store stock matches the warehouse

slides.title: Honest delivery dates
slides.body: Assistants compare delivery dates side by side. A clear date beats a vague promise.
slides.cost: Check: a real delivery date on every product

slides.title: Easy returns policy
slides.body: 33 in 100 shoppers say shipping and returns change what they buy. Make yours easy to find.
slides.cost: Check: 1 clear returns page, no fine print

slides.title: Questions answered
slides.body: Fit, care, warranty. Answer them once, on your site.
slides.cost: Check: your top 10 questions, answered on site
